column1: # One estimated just-noticeable difference per score column, in that column's units.
# Source: KonJND-1k (1,008 pairs, 640x480, 504 JPEG + 504 BPG, distorted level at each
# image's mean picture-wise JND threshold, round-half-up), scored by the upstream Python
# packages (CPU fp32); value = pooled median score over the 1,008 pairs.
# Method, per-codec rows and quartiles: benchmarks/nn_konjnd_scale_2026-10-15.md
# Used by tests/parity.rs to express engine tolerance in JND units.
# ckdn and afine have image-dependent identical-pair scores, so their JND is
# a pooled median over score(pair) - score(ref, ref) per reference, from the
# Rust port (zenmetrics-cli, ort-cuda) rather than an upstream package:
# |delta| for ckdn, the SIGNED delta for afine (afine_all is a signed raw
# score; 12% of its deltas are negative).
# ckdn is higher-is-better; afine is lower-is-better (raw afine_all).
# dreamsim is lower-is-better with identical-pair score exactly 0, so its JND
# is the plain pooled median, also from the Rust port (same engine/host).
